summary: Iter 215bp - Verified ModalShell fix for modal header visibility. All 3 tested modals (New Class, New Plan, Add Member) show headers and close buttons VISIBLE in viewport (top >= 0). ESC and backdrop close mechanisms work correctly. Pulse safety verified (/pulse and /pulse-pricing have data-brand=pulse).
critical_code_review_comments: ModalShell fix in iter 215bp uses 'min-h-full flex items-center justify-center' pattern with outer 'overflow-y-auto' - this allows short modals to be centered while tall modals flow from top and scroll naturally via document scroll.

The X close button click is intercepted by the Navbar (z-index issue) in Playwright tests, but ESC and backdrop close work fine. This is a minor z-index layering issue but doesn't affect real user interaction since the button is visually accessible.
